skeleton: unheaded introduction ending with 'Here, we ...' and the headline numbers
Results: one subsection per figure, evidence ladder of the field (see references/article-architecture.md, section 1)
Discussion: recap in ladder order, limitations, next step
must_have: measured vs simulated labelled in the abstract
every abstract number matches the body with the same qualifier

style.attribution: concept, mechanism or claim as the grammatical subject, citation at the end of the clause; 'A et al. reported ... [3]' for landmark or disputed results; reference-as-subject ('[3] reported') only where the venue uses it; one convention throughout (see references/article-architecture.md)

abstract_note: journal-specific: check the current guide (for example Nature Communications and Nature Electronics set their own limits)
basis: typical ranges for full reviews in Nature Reviews, Chemical Reviews, Advanced Materials and similar journals; take the binding limits from the target journal's author guide and two or three recent reviews in that journal
